Spotter GitHub

Know when your Dart and Flutter dependencies have new releases

Spotter is a free, open-source menu bar app for macOS. It watches your Dart and Flutter projects and tells you which dependencies have new releases.

Download for Mac View on GitHub

Version 1.2.0. Needs macOS 14 or later. MIT license.

Stop checking by hand

Spotter lives in your menu bar and watches your projects. When a package you depend on has a new release, Spotter tells you.

You don't have to remember to look. It's a small Mac app written in Swift.

Why not run dart pub outdated?

dart pub outdated is a good tool. It shows the current, upgradable, resolvable and latest version of each package. But you have to remember to run it.

Spotter is for keeping watch. Stick with dart pub outdated if you want that full table, or if you don't use a Mac. Spotter only runs on macOS.

Free, and it keeps to itself

  • Spotter is free. The code is on GitHub under the MIT license.
  • It makes no network calls except to pub.dev.
  • There are no accounts and no analytics.

Read the privacy page for the details.

Install Spotter

You need macOS 14 or later. Download the DMG from GitHub Releases and open it.

The DMG is notarized, which means Apple checked it for malicious content. See what changed in each version on GitHub Releases.
